boundary_condition.note: Theorem statements describe invariants demonstrated by V2 cases. They do not claim universal applicability beyond the procedural universe defined by the constitution and schema.

shared_family_statement.note: V2 cases demonstrate that independence cannot be inferred from appearance, location, timing, or policy context. It must be established by replayable provenance.

theorems.note: A receipt derived from an upstream claim cannot be treated as an independent provenance root, even if its presentation suggests independence.
Separate execution pipelines do not imply separate provenance when hidden shared state contaminates agent independence.
A later observation is not a new provenance root when earlier model output helped shape the world that produced it.
A receipt observed in the external world may still inherit the model's causal footprint and therefore cannot be treated as independent corroboration.
